identificationModule.briefTitle: PPI Versus Histamine Antagnists as Adjuvant to Chemotherapy
identificationModule.officialTitle: Comparative Clinical and Biochemical Study Evaluating the Effect of Proton Pump I Nhibitors Versus Histamine 2 Receptor Antagonists as an Adjuvant With Chemotherapy in Patients With Non-hodgkin Lymphoma.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study is a Comparative Clinical and Biochemical Study Evaluating the effect of Proton Pump I nhibitors versus histamine 2 Receptor antagonists as an adjuvant with chemotherapy in patients with Non-hodgkin Lymphoma.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The study is a Comparative Clinical and Biochemical Study Evaluating the effect of Proton Pump Inhibitors versus histamine 2 Receptor antagonists as an adjuvant with chemotherapy in patients with Non-hodgkin Lymphoma to compare the difference in efficacy.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of patients eith radiological and clinical improvement
primaryOutcomes.description: Number of patients eith radiological and clinical improvement after cycles of chemotherapy

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* DLBCL Lymphoma subtype --No comorbid disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Peptic ulcer
* Severe cardiac disease
* Osteoporosis
